blocks.title: scan to play — Interactive Materials Lab
blocks.description:
A series of mini games with animated and disguised barcodes played with a barcode scanner.

Built in p5.js with barcode scanner configured as keyboard input.

By Interactive Materials Lab in the Division of Industrial Design at the National University of Singapore.

Showcased at:
BYOX,  Singapore Design Week 2025 
Prototype Island, Milan Design Week 2026

[https://interactivematerials.info/scan-to-play](https://interactivematerials.info/scan-to-play)

blocks.title: One ball on Hypnotron II
blocks.description: In 2018, the Aziz!LightCrew developed a groundbreaking new concept for pinball: A traditional playfield is augmented by custom interactive projections. From 2018 till 2024 we built our prototype game "Hypnotron II" to showcase the potential of this technology. Do check out our early concept video: https://vimeo.com/1070239971 Contact us: AzizPinball@posteo.de

blocks.title: Star Mining Co. by Barney Whiteman | Made with Processing
blocks.description: Use your customisable super-drill to carve your way through procedurally generated asteroids to reveal the riches within. Use your new wealth to buy upgrades for even faster destruction! But be careful - failure to make a profit for Star Mining Co. will terminate your contract, and YOU, permanently!

blocks.title: Fragment Collapse by Barney Whiteman | Made with Processing
blocks.description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

blocks.title: TRAUMAGOTCHI by Lark VCR, made with p5.js
blocks.description:
‧͙⁺˚*･༓☾　Website ☽༓･*˚⁺‧͙ for virtual spell-casting, collective healing, and general DeepMachineIncantation ＊*•̩̩͙✩•̩̩͙* Mindchild of Lark VCR ˚*•̩̩͙✩•̩̩͙*˚＊ Text by Charity Porpentine Heartscape.

Visitors to [www.traumagotchi.com](http://www.traumagotchi.com/) are directed to create a virtualization of their trauma: their Traumagotchi. These Traumagotchi tend to the DeepInTheMachineWorld TraumaCompostShrine. While the website is active, the code in the shrine casts virtual spells for healing in the CPU, GPU, and interweb astral-sphere.

Traumagotchi can be fed, bathed, and rested. Users may program these VirtualSelfCare actions to reoccur every five minutes or 60 seconds. Users can also release words and set intentions at the DeepInTheMachineWorld TraumaCompostShrine.

blocks.title: Atlås | Binaura
blocks.description: Atlås is an anti game environment that generates music among a conversational cognitive space. As part of its existence, there are automatically generated tasks that are solved by machine intelligence without the need of human input. It also asks questions ad infinitum: questions that are dealing with presence, human cognition and imagination, corporate driven automatisms, advanced listening practices, silence.
